# Ambrose

[Grit](../codex/factions.md#grit)

## Overview

- **Age:** roughly fifty (since v4)  <sub>[v4 CHAPTER 9 AN EVENING AT SEVEN GULLS POINT P36](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0036)</sub>
- **Role:** clergyman  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P5](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0005)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_

## Appearance

Ambrose maintains an unshaven face and long, untrimmed hair as part of a vow related to the [Grits](../codex/factions.md#grit).

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 9 AN EVENING AT SEVEN GULLS POINT P34](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0034)_

## Personality

Ambrose is a resolute, hearty, and twinkly individual with the strength of an ox. Possessing a somewhat quick temper, he tends to take things lightly and often makes outrageous statements, though news of child mistreatment throws him into an absolute rage. Additionally, he is skilled at sharing entertaining tales and possesses an excellent tenor voice used for singing Scotch ballads.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 16 NEW YEAR’S EVE AT THE LIGHT P6](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0006), [v4 CHAPTER 16 NEW YEAR’S EVE AT THE LIGHT P9](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0009), [v4 CHAPTER 35 POLITICS AT SEVEN GULLS P32](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0032), [v4 CHAPTER 37 MISS WINIFRED MAKES A STARTLING ANNOUNCEMENT P15](../source/v04-c37.md#nw-v04-c37-p0015), [v4 CHAPTER 37 MISS WINIFRED MAKES A STARTLING ANNOUNCEMENT P17](../source/v04-c37.md#nw-v04-c37-p0017), [v5 CHAPTER VIII. MISS WINIFRED INTERVENES P8](../source/v05-c08.md#nw-v05-c08-p0008), +3 more_

## History

During his younger years, Ambrose was a famous dancer who later took a vow during a fierce general election to refrain from cutting his hair or shaving his beard until the [Liberal](../codex/factions.md#liberal) party won power. On a New Year's Eve at the [Seven Gulls Point](../codex/places.md#seven-gulls-point) lighthouse, he entertained Captain Saul, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md), Hugh, and [Lorna](../character/lorna-vane.md) by singing and performing a wild dance with [Lorna](../character/lorna-vane.md). After the Liberals eventually secured an election victory, Ambrose shaved his beard, though [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) initially failed to recognize his newly clean-shaven face when they spoke. Soon after, [Winifred](../character/winifred-tolley.md) announced her upcoming marriage to him. Following their marriage, [Winifred](../character/winifred-tolley.md) consulted Ambrose when asked to take in an orphaned girl named Mary, and he agreed to adopt her.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 9 AN EVENING AT SEVEN GULLS POINT P34](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0034), [v4 CHAPTER 16 NEW YEAR’S EVE AT THE LIGHT P3](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0003), [v4 CHAPTER 16 NEW YEAR’S EVE AT THE LIGHT P6](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0006), [v4 CHAPTER 16 NEW YEAR’S EVE AT THE LIGHT P11](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0011), [v4 CHAPTER 16 NEW YEAR’S EVE AT THE LIGHT P21](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0021), [v4 CHAPTER 35 POLITICS AT SEVEN GULLS P6](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0006), +11 more_

## Relationships

### [Uncle Saul](../character/uncle-saul.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/ambrose--uncle-saul.md)

Ambrose is an acquaintance and fishing companion of [Uncle Saul](../character/uncle-saul.md), spending time with him at the [Seven Gulls Point](../codex/places.md#seven-gulls-point) lighthouse [R1]. During a New Year's Eve gathering at the lighthouse, Ambrose joined [Saul](../character/uncle-saul.md) and the visiting young people, entertaining the group with songs and dancing [S2]. [Saul](../character/uncle-saul.md) also keeps track of Ambrose's personal political vows, explaining to others that Ambrose had refused to cut his hair or beard until the [Liberal](../codex/factions.md#liberal) party won an election [S1], a victory that [Saul](../character/uncle-saul.md) later shared with the community [S3].

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 9 AN EVENING AT SEVEN GULLS POINT P13](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0013), [v4 CHAPTER 9 AN EVENING AT SEVEN GULLS POINT P19](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0019), [v4 CHAPTER 9 AN EVENING AT SEVEN GULLS POINT P23](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0023), +11 more_

- Friend of — acquaintances and fishing companions (since v4)  <sub>[v4 CHAPTER 9 AN EVENING AT SEVEN GULLS POINT P36](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0036), [v4 CHAPTER 16 NEW YEAR’S EVE AT THE LIGHT P18](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0018)</sub>
